# Address mapping and symbols (`address`)

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/generate.mjs. Do not edit; run `npm run generate` (drift fails `npm run check`). -->

Area `address` is owned by WP5-ADDR; its contracts live in `src/contracts/areas/address.ts`.

## `list_module_symbols` — List Module Symbols

List one module's exports, imports (with IAT slot) or .pdata function ranges (exact start and size), from the live process or from a PE file on disk (pe_path; no session needed). Filter by name substring; paged with a total. Names come from the PE itself, never from DebugSymbol guesses; non-exported functions appear only as unnamed .pdata ranges.

| Phase | Hints                 | Effects                                       | Gate | CLI                                      |
| ----- | --------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ---- | ---------------------------------------- |
| P1    | read-only, idempotent | readsTargetMemory, mutatesSession, idempotent | —    | `bea symbols <module>` (session-oneshot) |

| Input field  | Type                                                                    | Required | Default     | Description                                                |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `session_id` | string `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$` | no       | —           | Session id from spawn_process, attach_process or emu_open. |
| `pe_path`    | string ≤4096                                                            | no       | —           | Offline: an absolute path to a PE64 file (no session).     |
| `module`     | string ≤600                                                             | no       | `"$main"`   | Module name, quoted path or $main; ignored with pe_path.   |
| `kind`       | "exports" \| "imports" \| "functions"                                   | no       | `"exports"` |                                                            |
| `filter`     | string ≤256                                                             | no       | —           | Case-insensitive name substring.                           |
| `offset`     | integer 0..100000000                                                    | no       | `0`         |                                                            |
| `limit`      | integer 1..1000                                                         | no       | `200`       |                                                            |

Deadline 30,000 ms · input ≤ 1,048,576 bytes · evidence always as `bea.symbols.module` · sessions live, emulation, none · results carry untrusted target content.

## `map_address` — Map Address

Convert up to 64 address expressions between runtime VA, module+RVA and static VA (module:0xVA[/0xBASE]; base defaults to the ImageBase in the on-disk PE). Reports the enclosing .pdata function, the region, and whether verify_bytes live bytes equal the file bytes, so a Ghidra/REA address can be trusted before hooking. With pe_path and runtime_base it is pure arithmetic and needs no session.

| Phase | Hints                 | Effects                                       | Gate | CLI                                     |
| ----- | --------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ---- | --------------------------------------- |
| P1    | read-only, idempotent | readsTargetMemory, mutatesSession, idempotent | —    | `bea map <addresses>` (session-oneshot) |

| Input field             | Type                                                                    | Required | Default | Description                                                       |
| ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `session_id`            | string `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$` | no       | —       | Session id from spawn_process, attach_process or emu_open.        |
| `pe_path`               | string ≤4096                                                            | no       | —       | Offline: an absolute path to a PE64 file (no session).            |
| `runtime_base`          | string `^0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]{1,16}$`                                       | no       | —       | Offline only: the runtime base to map to.                         |
| `addresses`             | array<string ≤600> ≤64                                                  | yes      | —       |                                                                   |
| `verify_bytes`          | integer 0..64                                                           | no       | `16`    | Compare N live bytes with the file bytes (live only); 0 disables. |
| `expected_image_sha256` | string `^[a-f0-9]{64}$`                                                 | no       | —       | Ghidra 'Executable SHA256' or the REA subject digest.             |
| `symbols`               | array<object> ≤4096                                                     | no       | —       | Caller names (Ghidra/REA) to register for symbols_module.         |
| `symbols_module`        | string ≤600                                                             | no       | —       | Module the symbols belong to (default $main).                     |
| `symbols_source`        | "ghidra" \| "rea" \| "ida" \| "binja" \| "analyst" \| "other"           | no       | —       |                                                                   |
| `external_ref`          | object                                                                  | no       | —       |                                                                   |
| `sensitive_values`      | array<string ≤1024> ≤64                                                 | no       | —       | Literals to redact from evidence (each >= 4 UTF-8 bytes).         |

Deadline 30,000 ms · input ≤ 8,388,608 bytes · evidence always as `bea.address.map` · sessions live, emulation, none · results carry untrusted target content.
